text: Ever wondered how artificial intelligence actually works?
Is it really thinking like a human?
First, AI models are trained on massive amounts of data, like text, images, and code, learning patterns and relationships.
Inside the model, layers of artificial neurons process numbers.
During training, connections are adjusted to make predictions more accurate.
When you ask a question, language models break your words into tokens, process their context, and predict the next token, one step at a time.
AI does not need to think like us to generate convincing answers.
It uses learned patterns and mathematical calculations, and yes, it can still make mistakes.
That is artificial intelligence in sixty seconds!
